days.body:
Hey Jonny! So excited as you are going to communicate in Seminary on Thursday, August 20! You will be teaching during our Gospel Perspective series. This series highlights how the gospel changes everything: Eternity, Relationships, Thoughts & Emotions, Value & Identity, and Actions. 

 

Your day, you will be leading on a day where they will be working on their Gospel Project. 

  • I would love for the day you communicate if you would do a short reflection or something God has been highlighting in your life that relates to the gospel. It does not need to be anything crazy or too long (maybe around 10 minutes or so). Just make it you!
  • After this allow them to work on their projects! They should already be aware of exactly what this project is and know the groups they are in. 
    • If they want to go around campus to film, you can let them, just make sure they aren't just going to Coffee Co. to get a drink lol

Hey Jonesy! So excited as you are going to communicate in Seminary on Monday, August 24! You will be starting our Knowing God series. This series highlights who God is, including attributes, nature, and how we as Christians can come to know Him. 

 

You will be teaching the first day of this series, so I would love for you to introduce the topic.

 I would love it if you were to have some sort of teaching/reflection on God and then release them to their prayer groups for the last 15/20 minutes or so of class.

Hey Ronnie! So excited as you are going to communicate in Seminary on Wednesday, August 26! You will be teaching during our Knowing God series. This series highlights who God is, including attributes, nature, and how we as Christians can come to know Him. 

 

Your day, you will be leading through the day on the Trinity. 

 While the Trinity is complicated and hard to grasp, I believe it is essential for youth to understand that God is one being existing in three persons: Father, Son, and Spirit. I would love for you to show how the Father, Son, and Spirit can be seen throughout all of the Bible- both Old and New Testament.

Hey EmJ! So excited as you are going to communicate in Seminary on Wednesday, September 2! You will be teaching during our Knowing God series. This series highlights who God is, including attributes, nature, and how we as Christians can come to know Him. 

 

Your day, you will be leading through the day on how God Relates: and is loving, just, merciful, and faithful.

 

As the day you chose was a block day, classes will be around 2 hours long. You do not need to teach that long (I would encourage against it and to stick with 30-60 minutes). I would love for you to be highly relational throughout all of the class. Allow the class to get to know you and for you to get to know them. I would then teach (they love visuals and hands on activities). After your lesson, I would love it if you led through some sort of game or activity. It could be related with the content or just for relationship building! 


 On Wednesday's around 11:35am there will be a Barros pizza delivery guy to deliver pizzas (he normally parks on the street outside near the Jurassic park gates) for youth in 3rd and 5th period. Plates and napkins are in the Seminary closet in a bin labeled "Food Supplies."

 

 Attached is the seating chart for the month, if you could take attendance based off of that list. Thank you!!

Your day, you will be leading through the day on how God Relates: and is loving, just, merciful, and faithful.

As the day you chose was a block day, class will be around 2 hours long. You do not need to teach that long (I would actually encourage against it and to stick with teaching for around 30-60 minutes). I would love for you to be highly relational throughout all of the class! Allow the class to get to know you and for you to get to know them. I would then teach (they love visuals and hands on activities). After your lesson, I would love it if you led through some sort of game or activity. It could be related with the content or just for relationship building!  

 Attached is the seating chart for the month, if you could take attendance based off of that list. Thank you!!

Hey Caleb! So excited as you are going to communicate in Seminary on Monday, September 14! You will be in our Knowing God series. This series highlights who God is, including attributes, nature, and how we as Christians can come to know Him. 

 

You will be transitioning this series from youth learning attributes about who God is to private practices, so I would love for you to teach on the spiritual discipline of Community. 


 I would love it if you were to have some sort of teaching on then the discipline of Community and then release them to their prayer groups for the last 15/20 minutes or so of class. If you see the conversation is going well and you want more time focusing on it, you have all authority to do that and they can do prayer groups another time!

guide.title: Room Set-Up
guide.html:
Propping Open the Door

  1. Youth enter/exit from the gray double doors — prop the door with the doorstop inside.
  2. Once class has begun, close the door.

Set-up music — the monitor on the far left controls the Spotify connected to the top keyboard.

  1. Turn on the large soundboard with the switch on the back of the board near the plug.
  2. If the computer is off and the space bar doesn't wake the screen, turn it on with the silver button underneath the desk on the bottom of the box on the right.
  3. Password for both computers: 12345
  4. Open Spotify, play the playlist onto "this computer."
  5. On the soundboard, put the "pk" to D on the far left — this moves all sliders down.
  6. Move the "Spotify" volume adjuster up and the far-right "St Main" slider/fader up and unmuted.
  7. Click play on Spotify.

If none of this works, turn up volume on the board for Sonos 1 or 2 — you won't be able to change songs, only volume.

Set-up audio from your computer

  1. Make sure the soundboard is already on.
  2. Unplug the Aux cord from the left side of the Mac (far right of the desk).
  3. Plug into the aux port on your computer.
  4. Turn up the "SFX" slider on the soundboard.

Set-up projector/slides

  1. Turn on the projector with the touch screen under the monitors (between the keyboards and "Carbonite switcher").
  2. Plug the HDMI cord and adapter into your computer and the box on the far right at the top.
  3. Make sure the "Carbonite switcher" is displaying HDMI — switch to "2" on the Program row if not.
  4. Connect the USB receiver (grey sleeve, top drawer, bottom of the remote) for the remote on the TV.
  5. Switch slides with the clicker (found in the drawer).

Set-up a microphone

  1. Grab the microphone labeled "VOX 1" on top of the tool cart.
  2. On the right half of the soundboard, click "F" for Pk.
  3. Unmute by clicking the red mute button above VOX 1.
  4. Turn up volume on VOX 1 using the slider.

Bibles

Stored in Room 2. The youth know where to find them; have one youth (the table leader) from each table grab the Bibles needed for their table.

guide.title: Room Shut Down
guide.html:
Soundboard

  1. Click the utility button on the soundboard screen.
  2. Click Power Down on the soundboard screen.
  3. Wait for the screen to say it's safe to turn off, then flip the switch on the back of the board by the plug.
  4. Put the cover over the console.

Projector — use the touch screen under the monitors to power it off.

Computer — do NOT shut down; put both computers to sleep.

Make sure all doors are shut before leaving, and anything left by youth is put in the storage closet.

guide.title: Student Expectations / Discipline
guide.html:
• They know and are expected to respect you and any decisions you make (even if it is different from what I normally do).
  • If they are being disruptive, disrespectful, or anything similar, you can ask for their phone and then send them to Room 1 or 2. Please let me know if you do this so I can have a conversation with them.
  • They are not supposed to be on their phones or laptops, unless they specifically ask you. If you catch them on their phones, you do not need to give them a warning, unless you think necessary (they already know). Take their phone if they go on it. They can then get their phone after class.
  • They have a seating chart (you guys can follow this, but if you want to be “the cool sub” you can let them sit where they want if they are respectful lol).
  • Please take attendance. I will give you their seating charts for each class period you can use as their attendance and just mark if there is a student absent. You can either text me a picture of these papers or leave on my desk!
